# `api.lookup.get_container_fills`

> `GET /lookup/containerfill` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.lookup.get_container_fills() -> list[LookupFillResult]
```

**CLI**

```bash

```

Discover valid 8_01 packing identifiers from the server.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `fillId` | `Optional[int]` | no | Fill id. |
| `code` | `Optional[str]` | no | Code. |
| `description` | `Optional[str]` | no | Description. |
| `defaultPercent` | `Optional[float]` | no | Default percent. |
